business_problem: In its ongoing quest to shape what the digital future holds for its clients, Atos is fully committed to giving them the most innovative solutions and making their digital transformation smooth and seamless. Its biggest challenge in all of this is to optimize workplace processes in terms of both efficiency and cost optimization, all with the aim of driving employee engagement.
solution_summary: In its ongoing quest to shape what the digital future holds for its clients, Atos is fully committed to giving them the most innovative solutions and making their digital transformation smooth and seamless. Its biggest challenge in all of this is to optimize workplace processes in terms of both efficiency and cost optimization, all with the aim of driving employee engagement. A group of selected Atos employees was recently given the chance to try out Copilot for Microsoft 365 for themselves. And the verdict? The AI program demonstrated just how crucial it can be in everyday processes and quickly established itself as a key partner in employee wellbeing. With Copilot for Microsoft 365, trialing is believing. Atos sees each employee’s workplace as a place of empowerment, a place where jobs are rethought. “In our eyes, it’s not tools or productivity in themselves that make an organization perform,” says Mélanie de Vigan, Digital Workplace Development Manager at Atos.

solution_components.name: Copilot for Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Assists employees inside Microsoft 365 apps with drafting, summarization, search, and task execution.

business_outcome: Within just a few short weeks, Copilot for Microsoft 365 proved its worth to the small group of 300 Atos employees handed licenses to test the program. In fact, it was so popular that Atos decided to distribute more Copilot licenses internally to promote take-up among coworkers and encourage entire teams to use the tool and share learnings.
metrics: The ultimate goal is to have 15,000 employees Copilot-trained by the end of 2024.
